headword: {管理|かんり}{栄養士|えいようし}

definitions.explanation: A nationally licensed nutrition professional in Japan, one rank above the {栄養士|えいようし}. They plan and manage diets and give nutritional guidance in hospitals, schools, and welfare facilities.

examples.japanese: {管理|かんり}{栄養士|えいようし}になりたい。
examples.english: I want to become a registered dietitian.

examples.japanese: {病院|びょういん}で{管理|かんり}{栄養士|えいようし}として{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: She works as a registered dietitian at a hospital.

examples.japanese: {管理|かんり}{栄養士|えいようし}の{資格|しかく}を{取|と}るには{国家|こっか}{試験|しけん}に{合格|ごうかく}しなければならない。
examples.english: To earn the registered dietitian qualification, you must pass the national examination.

notes:
A national qualification, ranked above the {栄養士|えいようし}. The licence is granted by the Minister of Health, Labour and Welfare after passing a national exam.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {管理|かんり}{栄養士|えいようし}の{資格|しかく}: registered dietitian qualification
- {管理|かんり}{栄養士|えいようし}{国家|こっか}{試験|しけん}: national exam for registered dietitians

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {栄養士|えいようし}: dietitian — a prefectural qualification with a narrower scope of practice
